title: Winey Moroccan Cherry Amlou
description: A sweet and gooey one-pot Moroccan dish featuring cherry and char-grill-yang flavors, suitable for an ayurvedic-rajasic diet
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the dried cherries, almond paste, honey, red wine, orange blossom water, ground cinnamon, and ground ginger
Place the saucepan over medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture is smooth and the cherries are rehydrated
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally
Stir in the unsalted butter until it is fully incorporated and the mixture is gooey and caramel-like
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly
Serve the amlou warm, garnished with toasted almonds or shredded coconut if desired
